page.overview:
Who is Dawson?

Dawson was a group captain in the Royal Air Force. The character appeared in the 1965 James Bond film Thunderball and was portrayed by Patrick Holt.

Dawson was responsible for overseeing a NATO training flight which was subsequently hijacked by SPECTRE.
